3.name: Frigid Explorer
3.notes:
You adapt to the harshest cold, gaining the following benefits:

Biting Cold. Your weapon attacks, Ranger spells, and Ranger features ignore Resistance to Cold damage.

Frost Resistance. You have Resistance to Cold damage.

Polar Strikes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d4 Cold damage (once per turn). This increases to 1d6 at Ranger level 11.

3.name: Hunter's Rime
3.notes:
When you cast Hunter's Mark, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Ranger level.

Additionally, a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark can't take the Disengage action.

3.name: Winter Walker Spells
3.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the listed Ranger levels:

3rd: Ice Knife
5th: Hold Person
9th: Remove Curse
13th: Ice Storm
17th: Cone of Cold

7.name: Fortifying Soul
7.notes:
As a Magic action, choose creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Each chosen creature regains Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Ranger level and gains Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition for 1 hour.

Usable once per Long Rest.

11.name: Chilling Retribution
11.notes:
When a creature hits you with an attack roll, take a Reaction to force it to make a Wisdom save (DC = your spell save DC). On a failed save, it is Stunned until the end of your next turn and its Speed becomes 0.

Usable a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), regaining uses after a Long Rest.

15.name: Frozen Haunt
15.notes:
When you cast Hunter's Mark, you may take on a ghostly, snowy form until the spell ends. Usable once per Long Rest, or again by expending a 4th-level or higher spell slot.

Frozen Soul. You gain Immunity to Cold damage. When you assume the form and at the start of each subsequent turn, creatures of your choice within a 15-foot Emanation take 2d4 Cold damage.

Partially Incorporeal. You gain Immunity to Grappled, Prone, and Restrained. You can move through creatures and objects as though they were Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force damage if you end your turn inside one. If the form ends while inside something, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space.
